hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and re-election crisis
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces mounting criticism over his economic policies, health speculations, and political strategies ahead of the 2027 elections. His government's austerity measures, public absence, and internal conflicts are fueling debates about his re-election prospects and governance effectiveness.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high stakes of Milei's economic reforms, the polarization around his leadership, and the looming 2027 elections, which are seen as a referendum on his policies.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) is leading in polls for the upcoming Saxony-Anhalt state election, raising concerns about far-right governance. The party's policies, including anti-immigration stances and calls to dismantle democratic institutions, are sparking intense debates and protests across Germany.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the existential threat the AfD poses to Germany's democratic institutions, its rapid rise in polls, and the polarized reactions it elicits from other political parties and civil society.
